bullets: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1: add check 5d that FAILs when retained BackgroundTaskBuilder code omits TaskEntryPoint (in-process model) with no OnBackgroundActivated handler, since WinUI 3 cannot dispatch in-process tasks and the Run control is silently dead even though check 5c passes

MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md > Background Tasks: document that in-process tasks (TaskEntryPoint omitted + App.OnBackgroundActivated) do not port to WinUI 3 and must be converted to the out-of-process model, and broaden the Register() guidance to use catch(Exception) with RequestAccessAsync inside the guard so registration failures always surface a status
